sourceControlGadget.description: Source control gadget to use for code analysis.

baseBranch.description: If running code analysis on a commit which has an open PR, the base base of the PR.

customEslintrc.description:
The contents of custom `.eslintrc` file defined in the repository on which the
Jarvis build was triggered, if defined.

customPrettierrc.description:
The contents of a custom `.prettierrc` file defined in the repository on which
the Jarvis build was triggered, if defined.

customPylintrc.description:
The contents of custom `.pylintrc` file defined in the repository on which the
Jarvis build was triggered, if defined.

baseCodeAnalyzerDeps.description:
The list of upstream dependencies for the baseCodeAnalyzer. When running code analysis through the Jarvis
pipeline, these packages will be ignored and no warning/non-fatal error will be thrown.

resolvedVersionsMap.description:
Packages written to the {@link Pkg.Store} instead of read from {@link ArtifactHub}
will only have the `{major}.{minor}.{patch}` version, not the full {@link SemanticVersion}.

When code analysis is being run through a [Release Management](Jarvis) pipeline, we'll
have access to the full semantic version for all packages written to the {@link Pkg.Store}.
A map of {@link Pkg#name} to their full semantic versions can be provided through this
field to ensure that the most accurate version for each package is collected.

packageName.description: The name of the package for which code analysis is being performed.

canonicalTesterCoverage.description: A JSON field containing the canonical tester coverage data.

previousSemanticVersion.description:
If this is specified, then all {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.Metric}s
will be run against this previous version of #packageName in addition to all
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric}s. The [pre-release components](SemanticVersion#preReleaseVersion)
and [build metadata](SemanticVersion#buildMetadata) are ignored; the latest
available [app info](BaseCodeAnalysis.AppInfo) for the `major.minor.patch`
version is always used.

@see BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#compareVersions

uninstrumentedArtifactZip.description:
When [code coverage is enabled](Jarvis.BranchGroup.TriggerOptions#enableJsServerCoverage),
the package source code contains instrumentation to collect code coverage data that doesn't
necessarily comply with certain {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric}s (for example, linting).

To avoid false positives from instrumented code, a separate ZIP containing the un-instrumented
source code must be provided here.
